maya: Quick sync — team asked if we're green to start the throughput ramp tomorrow for continuous-batching + KV-TTL change. Plan is: enable dynamic_batching on the hotpath, roll kvcache TTL from 1m -> 5m, and run the 10k-per-min load test. Need final owners and rollback steps. @sam @leo :eyes:
sam: infra quota issue still outstanding — filed with infra on Friday, infra-bot said 'pending capacity allocation'. ETA ~6h. If quota isn't cleared we can't spin up the extra canary nodes. Can we move to Fri AM? :calendar:
leo: I can own the runtime toggles and rollout script. Will open a tiny PR to add `--dynamic-batching=true` toggle and a feature flag check. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/4921 :github:
jordan: I'll coordinate observability: add a perf dashboard tile and a log filter for `kvcache.eviction.*` so we can watch hit-rate changes. I'll also add a heartbeat metric to the canary group. ETA 3h.
